messages:
emily: Customer reported free trial blocked at signup despite payment succeeding. Customer id C-98321. Email testuser@mailinator.com. Phone +1-415-555-0137. System returned risk_score=87 and flags [vpn_detected, disposable_email, phone_unverified]. IP 45.33.21.12 (us-east). Can we please review for manual grant?

mike: On it. Can you paste the fraud-check payload / response so I can see details?

emily: payload:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-98321",
  "email": "testuser@mailinator.com",
  "ip": "45.33.21.12",
  "risk_score": 87,
  "flags": ["VPN", "DISPOSABLE_EMAIL", "PHONE_UNVERIFIED"],
  "payment_method": "pm_1F5...",
  "matched_accounts": ["acct-5587", "acct-5590"]
}
```

mike: Quick notes: IP resolves to a cloud provider / known proxy ASN, disposable email detected (mailinator), and sms callback shows no delivery. Also saw two older accounts linked to same payment method. Could be reused card or fraud. @sasha do you want manual override?

sasha: @emily can you confirm the charge status and paste the device fingerprint? If payment captured and customer is willing to update contact info we can do a limited grant and monitor.

emily: Payment status: succeeded (charge id ch_3J2...). Device fingerprint: fpr_9a7b6c. Customer says they used temporary email because they wanted to avoid marketing, but insists account is legitimate.

ivan: I can do a case-level override. Proposed: 7-day trial grant, mark account with watch and require phone verification for future credits. Also create audit entry. Any objections?

sasha: Sounds good. Add throttles: lower token rate for first 24 hours and enable 30-day monitoring tag. Tell customer to update email to a non-disposable one and verify phone.

emily: I'll send the short customer reply: "We manually cleared a 7-day trial for your account. Please update your email and complete phone verification to keep access after the trial. If you didn't sign up, reply and we'll escalate." Sent.

fraud-bot: AUTO: manual override applied by ivan at 1970012580, action=trial_grant_7d, tags=[manual_review, watch30d], audit_id=OV-1970012580

mike: Logged override and saved logs to case C-98321. Closing thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
